name: abysslink-vex-suppression-proof-fixture
comment: Minimal SPDX SBOM for the VEX suppression proof (SUPL-03, Pitfall 3). It contains exactly one package carrying a KNOWN advisory (dgrijalva/jwt-go v3.2.0 -> CVE-2020-26160 / GHSA-w73w-5m7g-f7qc). Grype matches this advisory off the PURL below. The paired not_affected VEX (known-advisory.openvex.json) must carry the SAME PURL exactly, or suppression silently fails. This fixture is NOT a real project dependency; it exists only to prove --vex suppression genuinely changes Grype's exit status.
